correctness.rationale: For 3|m, J_m^2=0 and rank J_m=1, so clique factors yield J2 plus m-2 J1 summands. Frobenius gives nilpotence at most three of the commuting tensor sum. Direct squarefree-algebra calculations prove J2 tensor J2=J3+J1 and J3 tensor J2=2J3, yielding integer closed block multiplicities a,b,c. Companion-polynomial argument gives the exact temporal blocks, fixed dimensions, and sharp 9,12,18 orders; divisibility subtraction yields all primitive counts. Standard-library direct modular matrices, exhaustive H(1,3) state test, and integer recurrence checks independently matched all predictions, with finite checks expressly subordinate to the general proof.
